feeds.title: Fashion Premium Magazine
feeds.description: Fashion Premium Magzine, is a 100% Romanian fashion magazine. They have been present online since 2006, reworking fashion digitally. Here you can find the most interesting information from fashion, beauty, accessories, interviews, lifestyle, events, editorials, deco, and kids.

feeds.title: Footshop Romania Blog
feeds.description: Get started in the Footshop blog, where you will find stories from the world of sneakers, inspiring returns and tips on how to wear a knee-high outfit. Footshop Romania is a premium Sneaker store in the country bringing together an exclusive collection of top-tier shoe brands to your screen and doorsteps.

feeds.title: Style diary
feeds.description: Style Diary by Irina Markovits documents her Clothes and apparel shipping insights, recommendations, and more current fashion trends for you to follow. Irina is a style consulting and fashion journalism professional blogging to fellow women about aesthetic, stylistic, visual, and creative education in today's setting.

feeds.title: Andra Costa » Fashion
feeds.description: Andra Costa's blog section on Fashion & Beauty tips features Fashion stories, Outfit Styling tips, Fashion Weeks updates, and more. Andra Costa is a Fashion-Blogger based in Romania passionate about Clothes, Food, and Travel. She also likes to write and paint.

feeds.title: Urban.ro » Moda & beauty
feeds.description: Read the latest published articles on Fashion, Beauty, and wellness from Urban.ro. Urban.ro is a Lifestyle site where you can find news about theatre, film, music, dance, and musicals, recommendations for places to eat fine cuisine at affordable prices, and places to take your children on the weekend for fun educational activities.

feeds.title: Oxette Blog
feeds.description: Dressing tips, Clothes and accessories suggestions, guides for the latest trends, Gift ideas, and more from Oxette.com. Explore more of our brand collection in this blog. Oxette is a Greek brand of PERIDEO SA, a company actively involved in the production, distribution, and sales of jewelry, watches, and fashion accessories.

feeds.title: epantofi.ro Blog
feeds.description: Discover Tips, Fashion advice, and Culture trends. Our blog shares interesting reads on the evolution of and current trends in Romanian and Global fashion arena. The epantofi.ro blog is the best source of fashion inspiration, the latest trends, and styling ideas.

feeds.title: Ioana Dumitrache
feeds.description: Ioana Dumitrache shares her fashion wisdom along with her personal story and efforts taken to become a leading fashion blogger in Romania. Discovery the latest collection fro her showroom, styling tips, and more on trending fashion topics in this blog.

feeds.title: Shopping in Romania
feeds.description: News articles covering the Romanian Fashion scene, and also articles on Luxury Fashion, Street Style Fashion, Health & beauty, and traditional life. Shopping in Romania is a one-stop-shop website for all the latest information, guides, tips, and general vibe checks on Romanian and Global Fashion mood.

feeds.title: Dreamingof.net
feeds.description: Dreamingof.net takes its readers to amazing places, cool things, dazzling stories, and exquisite experiences to have in Romania. Alina Aliman the founder of dreamingof.net is a fashion journalist passionately covering dazzling stories of the vivid lifestyles and cultural experiences throughout Romania and the rest of the world.

feeds.title: Romania Fashion
feeds.description: Romania Fashion is an A-Z online resource that provides fashion insights and also covers the latest Romania Fashion news updates, Events, Interviews, Design extravaganzas, and more. At RomaniaFashion.ro, we represent the Romanian fashion system, with real, efficient, and always-updated data.

feeds.title: Avetisiperoz
feeds.description: Browse categories consisting of content on everything from Lifestyle, Fashion, Food, and Travel to personal stories and safety tips from Liana Popa. Liana is a fashion influencer and content creator from Romania. Her website Avetisiperoz.ro lists a catalogue of her creation and new launches from time to time.

feeds.title: Urban Style
feeds.description: Urban Style is a street fashion blog by Mariata Epuras, relaying the latest fashion updates and announcements. Contains street-style articles with, book reviews, movie reviews, fashion & lifestyle articles, health articles, fashion stores, art exhibitions, and events. Mariata is a manager at the company Maria Ta Travel and Adventure SRL.

feeds.title: Dana Rogoz » Outfits
feeds.description: Dana Rogoz posts about Outfits, Trendy wear tips & reccomendations, in Fashion, Beauty, Lifestyle and many other female-focused categories. She also shares snippets from her personal life. Dana Rogoz is a Romanian Influencer and Beauty blogger.

feeds.title: ELLE Romania » Fashion
feeds.description: Discover the fashion trends of the moment, fashion news, the latest collections from famous designers, unique fashion presentations, and must-have clothing pieces, but also cool & stylish recommendations from ELLE editors. ELLE produces daily relevant content for women on topics ranging from news to fashion and from celebrities to social causes, providing quality information and opinions about current events

feeds.title: AmiAmalia
feeds.description: Our blog gives out knitwear styling tips, fashion fundamentals, conversations with guest designers, and more chic stuff. AmiAmalia is a sustainable, slow fashion, boutique brand built on responsibility. We are a Norwegian - Romanian family, now living in Oslo after many years of working around the world, focused on creating a better one.

feeds.title: Sweet Paprika
feeds.description: Sweet Paprika blog by Gabriela Atanasov dishes out details and accounts of her latest Fashion travails and visits to famous brand stores. She also announces philanthropic efforts and personal stories here. Sweet Paprika.ro is an online fashion store by Gabriela featuring unique designs and a range of vintage products by local designers.

feeds.title: Emanuel Iuhas
feeds.description: Emanuel Iuhas is a Style blogger, online endorser, freelance stylist, lover & creative consumer of FASHION. He blogs about the Current trends in the Fashion Industry, and shares Personal styling tips for men, and his travel stories to various countries.

feeds.title: Roxi Rose
feeds.description: I'm Roxi Rose, I'm from Timisoara Romania and my mission is to help people find beauty in everything around them. This blog is a gate to everything beautiful and I find and tell my stories to people. Discover entertaining posts on Fashion, travel, and lifestyle among other categories.
